f3_program: older_than(at("jessica.age", "now"), at("claire.age", "now"), 6, "year", source("Jessica is six years older than Claire"))
observe(at("claire.age", "plus_2_year"), 20, "year", source("In two years, Claire will be 20 years old"))
query("value", at("jessica.age", "now"))
collection("ben.cards", "card", "ben", source("Ben has four boxes with ten basketball cards in each box"))
observe(at("ben.basketball_card_boxes.count", "initial"), 4, "count", source("four boxes"))
observe(at("ben.basketball_cards.per_box", "initial"), 10, "count", source("ten basketball cards in each box"))

product_relation(at("ben.cards.basketball.count", "initial"), at("ben.basketball_card_boxes.count", "initial"), at("ben.basketball_cards.per_box", "initial"), source("four boxes with ten basketball cards in each box"))
member("ben.cards", "ben.cards.basketball", source("basketball cards"))
observe(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_card_boxes.count", "gift"), 5, "count", source("five boxes"))
observe(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.per_box", "gift"), 8, "count", source("eight baseball cards"))

product_relation(at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.count", "gift"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_card_boxes.count", "gift"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.per_box", "gift"), source("five boxes with eight baseball cards"))

add("mother_gives_baseball_cards", "ben.mother", at("ben.cards.baseball.count", "current"), at("ben.mother_gift.baseball_cards.count", "gift"), source("His mother gave him five boxes with eight baseball cards"))
member("ben.cards", "ben.cards.baseball", source("baseball cards"))
transfer("ben_gives_cards_to_classmates", "ben", at("ben.cards.count", "current"), at("ben.classmates.cards.count", "current"), 58, source("he gives 58 cards to his classmates"))
query("remaining_count", "ben.cards", "current")
assumptions: The candidate program adopts the distributive reading that each of the five boxes contains eight baseball cards; the sentence does not explicitly say "in each box".

f3_program: collection("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018", "acquisition_payment", "singtel", source("Payments of S$123 million were made for the acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018 and S$344 million for the acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))

observe(at("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018.videology_assets", "august_2018"), 123, "S$ million", source("S$123 million were made for the acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018"))

member("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018", "singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018.videology_assets", source("acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018"))

remove("videology_acquisition_payment", "singtel", at("singtel.cash.amount", "current"), at("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018.videology_assets", "august_2018"), source("Payments of S$123 million were made for the acquisition of Videology assets in August 2018"))

observe(at("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018.airtel_africa_equity_interest", "october_2018"), 344, "S$ million", source("S$344 million for the acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))

member("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018", "singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018.airtel_africa_equity_interest", source("acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))

remove("airtel_africa_equity_interest_acquisition_payment", "singtel", at("singtel.cash.amount", "current"), at("singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018.airtel_africa_equity_interest", "october_2018"), source("S$344 million for the acquisition of a 5.7% equity interest in Airtel Africa in October 2018"))
query("sum", "singtel.investing_cash_outflow.acquisition_payments_2018", "2018")
assumptions: The phrase "in 2018" selects the August and October 2018 acquisition payments described in the cash-flow paragraph.

f3_program: observe(at("tom.sandbag.full_sand_weight", "full"), 250, "pound", source("250 pound sandbag"))
percent_of(at("tom.sandbag.sand_equivalent_weight", "current"), at("tom.sandbag.full_sand_weight", "full"), 80, source("Tom fills a 250 pound sandbag 80% full"))
percent_more(at("tom.sandbag.loaded_weight", "current"), at("tom.sandbag.sand_equivalent_weight", "current"), 40, source("the filling material he is using is 40% heavier than sand"))
query("value", at("tom.sandbag.loaded_weight", "current"))
assumptions: A "250 pound sandbag" denotes the sand load at full capacity.
The heavier-material comparison applies to equal-volume loads, and the empty bag's own weight is excluded.

f3_program: collection("overflow_parking_lot.patrons", "patron", "overflow parking lot", source("12 patrons who came in cars and 27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
observe(at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_cars.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
member("overflow_parking_lot.patrons", "overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_cars", source("12 patrons who came in cars"))
observe(at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_bus.count", "current"), 27, "count", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
member("overflow_parking_lot.patrons", "overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_bus", source("27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))

sum_relation(at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.count", "current"), at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_cars.count", "current"), at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.from_bus.count", "current"), source("There are 12 patrons who came in cars and 27 from a bus waiting in the overflow parking lot"))
observe(at("ellen.golf_cart.capacity.patrons_per_cart", "current"), 3, "count", source("Ellen can fit 3 patrons in a golf cart"))

quotient_relation(at("ellen.golf_cart.capacity.patrons_per_cart", "current"), at("overflow_parking_lot.patrons.count", "current"), at("ellen.golf_carts.needed.count", "current"), source("Ellen can fit 3 patrons in a golf cart"))
query("value", at("ellen.golf_carts.needed.count", "current"))
assumptions: The requested number of golf carts is interpreted as the number of cartloads, with each cartload filled to the stated capacity.
